surfaces: Rust-only setup.sh preflight, source build, configuration, and launch
Makefile Rust build, test, lint, install, and install-completions
secure bash, zsh, and fish completion installation
macOS arm64 host tarball with signed aarch64 guest bundle
unsigned macOS arm64 pkg with explicit signing status
unsigned macOS arm64 dmg with explicit signing status
Linux x86_64 host tarball with signed x86_64 guest bundle
Linux aarch64 host tarball with signed aarch64 guest bundle
standalone signed x86_64 and aarch64 guest bundle archives
cross-platform executable setup, staged Make install, archive, pkg, and dmg smoke

contracts.source_install: staged installs never mutate the invoking user home; live installs may install user completions
contracts.release_assets: host archives contain the matching guest bundle and public key; the key is trusted only after artifact attestation verification
contracts.installed_bundle_modes: root-owned guest executables are 0555 and public metadata, signatures, BPF objects, and trust roots are 0444 so the unprivileged host CLI can verify but not modify them
contracts.macos_signing: pkg and dmg are explicitly unsigned and never recommend disabling Gatekeeper globally
contracts.release_key: a protected base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 seed is required only in the tag release job and is passed to BuildKit as a secret
contracts.legacy_dependencies: no Swift toolchain, Package.swift, Node.js, npm, or copilot bridge is required
